title: The show had already started

pages.title: Read the situation
pages.instruction: Read for the facts and the different priorities
pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: The show had already started
paragraphs: Concert record: 7:15 pm, left home without the wristband collected earlier. 8:00 pm, show started. 8:20 pm, arrived at the venue. The digital ticket was still on the phone. The entrance’s closing time has not been stated.

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Did you enjoy the show, or was the whole evening difficult?
lines.audioText: Did you enjoy the show, or was the whole evening difficult?
lines.translation: Você gostou do show ou a noite toda foi difícil?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The show was great, but it had already started when we arrived
lines.audioText: The show was great, but it had already started when we arrived.
lines.translation: O show foi ótimo, mas já tinha começado quando chegamos

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: What time did you get there?
lines.audioText: What time did you get there?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: At eight twenty. We’d left late, and I’d forgotten my wristband at home
lines.audioText: At eight twenty. We’d left late, and I’d forgotten my wristband at home.
lines.translation: Às oito e vinte. Saímos tarde e eu tinha esquecido minha pulseira em casa

questions.prompt: Had the show started when Ana arrived?
questions.answer: Yes, the show had already started when Ana arrived

questions.prompt: What had she forgotten at home?
questions.answer: Ana had left her wristband at home

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Oh no. Couldn’t you just show your ticket?
lines.audioText: Oh no. Couldn’t you just show your ticket?
lines.translation: Ah, não. Você não podia só mostrar o ingresso?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The person at the entrance sent us to the help desk. We missed the opening act
lines.audioText: The person at the entrance sent us to the help desk. We missed the opening act.
lines.translation: A pessoa na entrada nos mandou ao atendimento. Perdemos a banda de abertura

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: At least you got in eventually. What would you check next time?
lines.audioText: At least you got in eventually. What would you check next time?
lines.translation: Pelo menos vocês acabaram entrando. O que conferiria da próxima vez?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: I’d check the ticket and wristband before leaving, and allow more time
lines.audioText: I’d check the ticket and wristband before leaving, and allow more time.
lines.translation: Conferiria ingresso e pulseira antes de sair e reservaria mais tempo

questions.prompt: Where was Ana sent at the entrance?
questions.answer: Ana was sent to the help desk

questions.prompt: What part of the show did she miss?
What would she check before leaving next time?
questions.answer: Ana would check her ticket and wristband before leaving

pages.title: Explain what happened first
pages.instruction: Use the information shown to answer Teacher’s questions and ask a follow-up question

rows.subject: The earlier past event
rows.example: She had forgotten her wristband before she left

rows.subject: Show the relationship
rows.verb: by the time / when + past event
rows.example: By the time they arrived, the show had already started

pages.title: Use the information to respond
pages.instruction: Reconstruct the evening. Explain what happened first and why it mattered

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: Check the real reason. Listen to both voice notes, then answer and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. I’ve checked what happened at the entrance in our concert story. They couldn’t get in immediately because one person had left their wristband at home. The entrance was still open at eight twenty, so closing time wasn’t the problem
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. I’ve checked what happened at the entrance in our concert story. They couldn’t get in immediately because one person had left their wristband at home. The entrance was still open at eight twenty, so closing time wasn’t the problem.
pages.greeting: I found out what happened at the concert entrance

items.answer: One person had left their wristband at home
No, the entrance was still open at eight twenty

items.prompt: How could they get a replacement wristband?
items.answer: They could show the digital ticket at the help desk

additionalAudios.audioText: The help desk could issue a replacement if they showed the digital ticket. They eventually got in, but the opening act had already finished. Could you explain the sequence to someone who thinks they were turned away because they arrived late?
